adjudication.title: Receipt verification is skipped when base audit is inconsistent, collapsing specific reasons and making 'digest_mismatch' a false label
adjudication.accepted: When inner audit validation failed, wrapper skipped receipt verification but labeled the result digest_mismatch. That causal diagnostic was unsupported by an actual digest comparison. Root changed the reason to audit_inconsistent.
adjudication.rejected: Consistent-audit cases do not all collapse to invalid_receipt: actual execution returns signature_invalid for a forged known-key signature, unknown_key for an unknown key, and invalid_receipt for absent/malformed receipt. Missing and malformed structure intentionally share a bounded invalid-receipt result.
adjudication.securityImpact: Every reproduced invalid case already rejected and exposed no verified audit; no unsigned fallback, acceptance or payment behavior was affected.
permanentChecks: Receipt verifier spy remains uncalled for inconsistent inner audit and reason is audit_inconsistent.
Actual CLI subprocess rejects unknown key, forged signature, missing receipt, disguised schema and inconsistent inner audit with precise reasons.
Explicit unsigned core remains exit0 and issuance unproven.
Child process network API is blocked for these CLI cases.

limits: DeepSeek source review is advisory; executable reproductions determine this decision.
The retained earlier Lab v24 cohort uses its original bytes/reason. It must not be rewritten as the corrected cohort.
Official issuance verifies the exact application export, not model judgment, backend truth, human identity or payment.
